intent: To illustrate the significant prevalence of fracking in new oil and gas well drilling.

units.meaning: Fracking (the highlighted orange segment) makes up 60% of new oil and gas wells — more than half.
accepted_routes: Fracking accounts for 60% of new wells, more than half.
The orange segment is 60%, so it is the majority share.
60% of new wells are fracking wells.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A segment or label showing 60% (or 0.60) for the orange category must appear.
units.reviewer_question: Should the 60% value be required to be explicitly labeled as fracking, not just as orange share?

optional_valid: Show relative proportions 0.60 and 0.40 instead of percent values.
Label the two categories as orange and blue exactly as in the table.
Show that the donut has only two segments.
unsupported_to_avoid: Claiming the blue 40% is specifically non-fracking unless the color/category mapping is established.
Claiming 60% of all oil and gas wells rather than new wells.
Claiming fracking caused an increase or trend over time.
Extrapolating to future drilling or total wells.
Using 20 or 50 as raw table values without showing the 60−40 or (60+40)/2 derivation.
notes: Table labels are generic orange/blue shares, while intent and narration supply the fracking framing. The reviewer must decide required mapping and whether complementary share, gap, or sum are obligatory or optional.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only

trim.reason: 人工逐条指定：删除/合并
